# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTERED_PULLBACK_TO_VWAP_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Elevated VIX heightens mean-reversion; price deviations above VWAP tend to reverse, providing short opportunities when the extension shows bearish momentum and above-average volume. This setup explicitly fades VWAP extensions under high VIX—a logic absent from any registered or killed strategy.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If VIX > 25 and price is > 0.3×ATR(20) above VWAP, and the current bar closes bearish (close < open) with volume > 1.3× the average volume of the last 20 bars, enter short at the close of that bar.  
Exit shape: Stop at the higher of the bar's high or VWAP + 0.5×ATR(20); initial target at 1.5× risk; after achieving 1× risk, trail a runner using a premium-stop of 10% of the underlying price.  
Regime hint: Intended for high-volatility regimes (VIX>25) during mid-day (11:00-14:00 ET) when intraday mean-reversion is strongest; avoid low-VIX (<15) environments where the edge diminishes.
